info.title: Roamify Server API
info.description: Full API docs for all currently registered routes. Email verification is sent through SMTP and admin routes require a JWT for a user with role=admin. Google OAuth2 flow added in v1.3.0.

post.description: Creates a user account immediately and sends the verification email asynchronously via SMTP.

201.description: User registered successfully. Check your email to verify.

get.description: HTML landing page used by verification links sent through email.
JSON email verification endpoint kept for API clients.

post.description: Allows the authenticated user to join the trip themselves. Creator privileges are not required. If the user was invited previously, their membership is marked as joined.
Uploads an image file to Cloudinary. Auth required. Accepts multipart/form-data.

get.description: Admin-only endpoint. Requires a valid bearer JWT whose user role is admin.
Returns all trips across all users. Requires authentication.

Redirects the browser to Google's OAuth2 consent screen. The user grants permission and Google redirects back to /api/v1/auth/google/callback. This is a browser redirect — not a JSON endpoint — so do not call it with fetch().

307.description: Temporary redirect to Google's consent screen

Set-Cookie.description: Short-lived CSRF state cookie (oauth_state, HttpOnly, Secure, 5 min TTL)

500.description: Google OAuth is not configured on the server (GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID missing)

get.description: Handles the redirect from Google after the user grants consent. Exchanges the authorization code for a Google access token, fetches the user's profile (email, name, avatar), then finds or creates the Roamify account and issues a JWT. On success the browser is redirected to FRONTEND_URL/oauth-success?token=JWT. On failure it is redirected to FRONTEND_URL/oauth-error?error=CODE&message=TEXT. This endpoint is called by Google, not directly by your frontend.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: CSRF state token that must match the oauth_state cookie

parameters.name: error
parameters.description: Set by Google when the user denies consent (e.g. access_denied)

get.description: Returns the chat history for the trip in chronological order. Only accessible to trip members. Use the `limit` query parameter to control how many messages are returned (default 50, max 200).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Max number of messages to return (1–200, default 50)

post.description: Sends a message to the trip's squad chat. Only joined trip members can send messages.

400.description: Invalid trip ID or empty message body

403.description: User is not a member of this trip

bearerAuth.description: Use a JWT returned by /api/v1/auth/login. Admin endpoints also require the token owner's role to be admin.
